<div class="card-body">
'''Wyron Serper''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ワイロン・サーパー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに相手の手札から無作為にX枚のカードを選んで見ることができる。X＝同じ位置の[Dark Side Force]の本数である。さらに、自分が運命数を引いた場合、カード名にスキャン／スキャナー／探査が含まれるカードの運命数は＋2となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wyron-Serper-PSA-89232348.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍のスパイ。スター・デストロイヤー・アヴェンジャーにセンサー技師として潜伏していた。ホス星系の小惑星を通して帝国軍艦をスキャンする任務に就いている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Wyron Serper.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, you may look at X cards chosen at random from opponent's hand. X is the number of Dark Side Force icons at the same location. Also, when you draw destiny, a card whose title contains scan, scanner, or probe is destiny +2.

'''Lore:'''
A Rebel spy. He was undercover as a sensor technician on the Star Destroyer Avenger. He is assigned to scan Imperial ships through the asteroids of the Hoth system.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Destiny bonus lists スキャン／スキャナー／探査 rather than 'scan' in the title.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Wyron Serper]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
